_source: Weekdays 2022-01-03..2026-10-01 with no regular (normal) session in the stored NIFTY50 1m data (muhurat-only days count as holidays: no regular trading); plus the remaining 2026 weekday holidays from NSE circular NSE/FAOP/71777 (12 Dec 2025). 2026 up to Oct 1 was cross-checked against that circular: identical except 2026-01-15, a holiday declared later (municipal elections).
_note: Trading holidays used for expiry shifts. Edit when NSE publishes a new year's list (2027: NSE circular expected in Dec 2026). A date missing here is treated as a trading day.
